result:
**Answer:** Two chart files import the framework's `Concept` type from `@openmrs/esm-framework`. Only the obs table actually reads its fields, so it is the one most likely to be affected by a behaviour change. The framework declaration is `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-api/src/types/concept-resource.ts:4-18`. It has `name`, `datatype`, `conceptClass`, `set`, `names`, `mappings`, `answers` and `setMembers`.

**Confirmed users of the framework `Concept`**

1. **`obs-table-horizontal.component.tsx`** is the main consumer. It imports `type Concept` at line 13 and uses it for the `concepts` prop on `HorizontalTable` (line 274) and `Cell` (line 381). The `ObsTableHorizontal` body reads `concepts` from `useObs` (line 78). It builds a uuid lookup (line 116), uses `display` for row headers (line 131), and reads `.dataType` at line 327 to choose the cell editor. The framework `Concept` declares `datatype`, not `dataType`. The read still compiles only because `OpenmrsResource` has an `[anythingElse: string]: any` index signature (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-api/src/types/openmrs-resource.ts:3-5`), so a change to these fields would not be caught by TypeScript.
2. **`postOrders.ts`** uses `Concept` only as a type in `ObsPayload.concept: Concept | string` (line 132). I found no runtime use of `concept` in that file. It is type-only and unlikely to be affected at runtime. `postOrders` is called from `order-basket.component.tsx:154`.

**Likely affected, not confirmed by a type import**

- **`useConcepts.ts`** fetches `custom:(uuid,display,datatype,answers)` and maps `datatype.name` to `dataType`. It doesn't import the framework type, but it depends on the same REST shape the framework `Concept` describes. If `datatype` or `answers` changed, this breaks first.
- **`useObs.ts`** declares its own `concepts` shape with `dataType` (lines 9-19) and fills it from `useConcepts` (lines 75-86). It is the source of the `concepts` value that the obs table consumes.

**Name clashes, excluded**

Other `Concept` declarations in the chart are local types, not the framework's. These are `esm-patient-notes-app/src/types/index.ts`, `esm-patient-tests-app/src/types.ts`, `esm-form-entry-app/src/app/types/index.ts`, `esm-patient-common-lib/src/orders/types/order.ts`, and `useVisitAttributeType.tsx`. The tests-app and notes-app files that import `Concept` do so from their own `../types`.

**Not checked**

- Other Falkon repositories, such as the patient-management, billing and laboratory apps, which may also import the framework `Concept`. The question was scoped to the chart app.
- Runtime shape changes in REST responses, which the type search can't see.
- The `find_symbol_definitions` call failed because I used the wrong repo name (`openmrs-esm-core` instead of `github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-core`). I got the definition by grep instead.
